scope: Read-only visual inspection of the actual decoded gallery images listed below. No rendering or native app interaction was performed for this review.
method: Each PNG was displayed through the image viewer at its full 1600 x 1000 image size and visually inspected. Observations describe visible content, not conclusions inferred from filenames.
overall: The requested landmark, fountain, park, harbor and shoreline compositions are readable in the reviewed day and night stills. Vehicles, moored boats, lights and water reflections are visible where described below. No source change was requested by this bounded release review.
limits: This review does not certify animation smoothness, temporal reconstruction, frame pacing, collision clearance or complete walkthrough coverage.
Only these twelve starting-gallery stills were reviewed; other views and intermediate camera poses are outside this report.
Procedural trees, distant facades, fountain jets and selected street junctions remain visibly simplified.
A rendered still cannot establish survey accuracy or faithful real-world photometry.

images.review: No blocking framing defect observed in this still.
observations: Wrigley clock faces, black hands, white facade relief, upper arches and dome are readable together.
Tribune has a warmer illuminated shaft and visible Gothic crown; the street corridor separates both landmarks.
limitations: The foreground Wrigley body extends outside the left and bottom edges; this is an elevated gateway view rather than a complete elevation.

images.review: No blocking framing defect observed in this still.
observations: The dark tapered tower and both full antennas stand against the sky; lit windows reveal portions of the diagonal structure.
The shoreline curves away at right, with a sparse line of road lights.
limitations: The lower tower is partly behind foreground buildings; night structural diagonals have less contrast than the daytime view.

images.review: No blocking framing defect observed in this still.
observations: The complete central fountain basin and its arcing jets remain unobstructed.
Warm and pale cyan illumination reflects in the pool; surrounding path lights describe the radial landscape layout.
limitations: Water jets read as smooth authored arc geometry; the image does not demonstrate spray simulation or water motion.
Foreground foliage is dark at night but does not hide the central fountain.

images.review: No blocking framing defect observed in this still.
observations: A broad skyline sits above the landscaped park; the distant fountain remains visible above and beside foreground foliage.
Sparse cars occupy the right-hand divided road, with white headlights and red rear lights visible.
limitations: Foreground trees partially hide the distant fountain; this is the wider park-and-road composition.
A still cannot verify vehicle speed, movement, spacing over time or freedom from temporal trails.

images.review: No blocking framing defect observed in this still.
observations: Finger piers, small white boat cabins and marina lights are visible against the dark water.
Broken vertical light reflections and surface ripples establish the harbor water plane.
limitations: The water and foreground quay are dark in the nighttime frame; boats and piers are easier to distinguish by day.
The still does not demonstrate boat or water animation.
